scripts.kill: powershell -Command "@(5000,5173,5174) | ForEach-Object { $p = (netstat -ano | Select-String ":$_\s").Line -split '\s+' | Select-Object -Last 1; if($p){ taskkill /PID $p /F 2>$null } }"
scripts.fresh: npm run kill && npm run dev
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
